from harness import *
import hashlib, json
T = "<<random_string>>"
def h(seed, coord, occ=0):
    return hashlib.sha256(('%s/%s/%d'%(seed,coord,occ)).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
seed='sd'
d = doc(seed=seed, timeout_ms=10,
  cases=[case('c0',[
      {"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[T, T],[T,'x']],"End_Stream":False},   # frame 0: pairs 0,1
      {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":T+T,"End_Stream":False},                    # frame 1
      {"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":T},                                     # frame 2
  ]), case('c1',[{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{T:T},"End_Stream":True}])],
  events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[T,T]],"end":False},
          {"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":T+T,"end":True}],
  channels=[ch('ch',[('c0',T),('c1',T+T)])])
o = run(d, debug=True)[0]
print(json.dumps(o)[:100])
# verify payload_bytes for case c0: header names/values lengths
exp_pairs = [(h(seed,'case/0/frame/0/h/0/n'), h(seed,'case/0/frame/0/h/0/v')),
             (h(seed,'case/0/frame/0/h/1/n'), h(seed,'case/0/frame/0/h/1/v'))]
exp_data = h(seed,'case/0/frame/1/data',0)+h(seed,'case/0/frame/1/data',1)
exp_dg = h(seed,'case/0/frame/2/data')
pb = sum(len(a)+len(b) for a,b in exp_pairs) + len(exp_data) + len(exp_dg)
print('payload_bytes expected', pb, 'got', o['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'])
# sent receipt
rec = b''
rec += (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'H'+(2).to_bytes(8,'big')
for a,b in exp_pairs:
    rec += len(a).to_bytes(8,'big')+a.encode()+len(b).to_bytes(8,'big')+b.encode()
rec += bytes([0])
rec += (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'D'+len(exp_data).to_bytes(8,'big')+exp_data.encode()+bytes([0])
rec += (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'G'+len(exp_dg).to_bytes(8,'big')+exp_dg.encode()+bytes([0])
def naive(b):
    x=0
    for y in b: x=(x*257+y+1)&((1<<64)-1)
    return {'n':len(b),'h':'%016x'%x}
print('sent expected', naive(rec), 'got', o['cases'][0]['sent'])
# received
rec2 = (1).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'h'+(1).to_bytes(8,'big')
n0=h(seed,'event/0/h/0/n'); v0=h(seed,'event/0/h/0/v')
rec2 += len(n0).to_bytes(8,'big')+n0.encode()+len(v0).to_bytes(8,'big')+v0.encode()+bytes([0])
d1 = h(seed,'event/1/data',0)+h(seed,'event/1/data',1)
rec2 += (2).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'd'+len(d1).to_bytes(8,'big')+d1.encode()+bytes([1])
print('recv expected', naive(rec2), 'got', o['cases'][0]['received'])
print('body expected', naive(d1.encode()), 'got', o['cases'][0]['response_body'])
# channel bytes: part0 = T for c0 coordinate channel/0/part/0/data ; part1 = two tokens
p0 = h(seed,'channel/0/part/0/data').encode()
p1 = (h(seed,'channel/0/part/1/data',0)+h(seed,'channel/0/part/1/data',1)).encode()
print('channel expected', naive(p0+p1), 'got', o['channels'][0]['bytes'])
# case c1 headers_kv coordinate check via payload_bytes
kv = h(seed,'case/1/frame/0/h/0/n'), h(seed,'case/1/frame/0/h/0/v')
print('c1 payload expected', len(kv[0])+len(kv[1]), 'got', o['cases'][1]['payload_bytes'])
